scope: 24 spaces, 45 coordinated still views and materials/build record. No video production in this option build.
interpretation: Use brown oak, polished stainless and continuous no-leg bases as shared materials. Cabinet silhouettes, hardware and face arrangements differ room by room; the owner photo is not an exact furniture template.
globalStyle: The owner clarified that the supplied furniture photo is MATERIAL inspiration, NOT a template to copy. Shared identity: smoky BROWN OAK with natural open grain, polished STAINLESS STEEL accents, and solid continuous floor bases without visible legs.
